title: Scout Runtime Execution Blueprint
description: Defines the executable plan produced from an approved Business Judgement. The blueprint specifies how work should be performed, sequenced, routed, validated, approved, recovered, and completed without containing the final execution output.

examples.title: Create the Next Xiaohongshu Content Package

objective.statement: Create one new Xiaohongshu content package that extends the approved content strategy without repeating covered themes.
objective.expected_outcome: A complete, standards-compliant six-page content package ready for human review.
objective.business_value: Sustain content cadence while strengthening BUXA PDMS positioning.
objective.success_definition: The package passes product, brand, content, and factual-quality gates.

execution_strategy.approach: Select a differentiated topic, generate the package, and validate it before returning the result.
execution_strategy.rationale: The content package has clear dependencies and should not be published automatically.

steps.title: Select a New Topic
steps.description: Compare approved historical themes and select a non-repetitive extension.

actions.instruction: Compare covered themes, identify gaps, and rank new topic candidates.

success_criteria.description: The selected topic does not duplicate an approved previous theme.

steps.title: Generate Content Package
steps.description: Generate the complete six-page Xiaohongshu package.

actions.instruction: Generate the image plan, prompts, title, post copy, and hashtags.

success_criteria.description: All requested package components are present.

steps.title: Run Quality Assurance
steps.description: Validate the package against all applicable standards.

actions.instruction: Evaluate the package against Product, Brand, and Content Standards.

checks.description: Product claims comply with approved Product Standards.
Content complies with Xiaohongshu Content Standards.

completion_criteria.description: The quality-check terminal step is completed.

confidence.basis: Based on the bounded execution blueprint scope.

estimated_effort.notes: Human effort is limited to reviewing the final package.

confidence.basis: Supported by the referenced Runtime evidence and validation results.
